annotations.title: Make a series of faceless short videos (Content Factory)

description: CONTENT FACTORY: turn ONE topic into a SERIES of faceless short videos (narration over pictures, no presenter), optionally in the STYLE of a trending reference video. Give `topic` ("make a video about…"), `episodes` (1-10, default 1) or your own `episodeTitles`, `durationSeconds` (20-120 per episode, default 30) and optionally `reference` (a TikTok / Reel / YouTube Short / Facebook / X link or a video file URL whose look, pacing, opening hook and caption style every episode copies; never its words or characters). Find a trending reference with search_tiktok / search_instagram / search_youtube when the user wants one. THREE STEPS, ALWAYS IN THIS ORDER: (1) call with no `confirm` for a FREE quote of the whole series (per episode and total); (2) optionally `planOnly:true` to see the episode titles and the style card first (a small planning charge); (3) `confirm:true` (pass the `plan` from step 2 to reuse it) queues every episode and returns their job ids; poll get_job. Each finished episode can be scheduled with this tool again: pass `jobIds` plus `schedule` {channels, at, everyHours, timezone} and it books one post per finished episode, spaced `everyHours` apart (default 24). Captions follow the reference (on if it burns words on screen) unless `captions` says otherwise.

captions.description: burn subtitles of every spoken word. Default: on only when the reference itself burns its spoken words as subtitles, otherwise off; nothing else is ever put on screen (no app screens, URLs, cards or stickers) unless the user asks

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to start rendering (real spend). Without it you get a free quote

episodeTitles.description: your own episode titles, in order (sets the episode count)

format.description: renderer lane: 'explainer' (default; exact length) or 'faceless_channel' (2K, whole 10s blocks)

jobIds.description: SCHEDULE MODE: the episode job ids to schedule (finished ones are booked)

plan.description: the `plan` a planOnly call returned, to run it without planning again

planOnly.description: write the episode plan and style card, render nothing (a small planning charge)

postCaptions.description: SCHEDULE MODE: one post caption per episode, in order (default: the episode title)

reference.description: a video link whose style every episode copies

schedule.description: SCHEDULE MODE: where and when the first episode posts; the rest follow every `everyHours` (default 24)

style.description: override the look in words (e.g. "flat 2D cartoon") instead of the reference's

topic.description: what the series is about, in the user's words
